name: Istán (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red with thin blue lines edging the white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Istán (a crescent above waves on blue and a tower and tree on white).
history: Municipal flag of Istán; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: thin lines edging the white stripe and blue field of the arms
